newsitem.title: USA: Omega Health revises some 1996 EPS downward.
newsitem.headline: Omega Health revises some 1996 EPS downward.

text.p: Omega Health Systems Inc said Friday it has revised downward its earnings per common share for the second quarter ended March 31, 1996 and the year ended December 31.
Omega now reports a loss of $0.22 per share for the quarter, instead of earnings of $0.05.
For all of 1996 the company now reports a loss per share of $0.03 instead of earnings of $0.20 per share.
This revision, said the company, has no effect on its earnings, cash flows or financial position, and there will be no effect from this change on any future period.

The company said that the revisions were a result of a March 28 SEC staff announcement requiring the recognition in earnings per share calculations of an imputed preferred stock dividend when convertible preferred stock is issued with a conversion price less than the quoted market price of common stock at the time of issuance.

Omega preovides a full range of services to optometry and ophthalmology practices, including management services, managed care programs, purchasing and marketing services and practice acquisition opportunities.
